arStrings.szText: "I don't know if that's a good idea. It could be dangerous."
Shall I drown it, or would you do that yourself? Dirty your pretty hands with such work?
Taunting. Sarcastic, meaning to provoke and belittle. Doesn't share the same concern.
I do not believe in waste. Lilith taught us the same. “What your enemies forge for your destruction shall be the instrument of their fall,” she said.
Plans are meant to bend and change. If this thing proves dangerous, I’ll kill it myself. I will not risk Sanctuary.
Frank. Brushing off the Player's concerns.
If this is the closest I can get to Lilith until her return, so be it. I hope our paths will never need to cross again.
